question: Can real-time or historical traffic data for Central Silk Board be legitimately obtained and used as simulation demand input?

sources_investigated.result: HTTP 401 — requires a licensed API key
sources_investigated.note: Commercial licence. Even with a key, redistribution of derived flow data into a published research artifact carries licence conditions this project cannot satisfy.

sources_investigated.probe: datastore resource lookup and catalog endpoint
sources_investigated.result: HTTP 302 / 404 — no matching traffic resource reachable unauthenticated

sources_investigated.source: Bengaluru Traffic Police / BSMILE open data
sources_investigated.result: No machine-readable traffic-volume API located. Available material is PDF project documentation (e.g. the OMR-to-Silk-Board DPR), not time-series flow data.

sources_investigated.coverage_claimed: 8,936 rows, 2022-01-01 to 2024-08-09, including 275 rows labelled 'Silk Board Junction' with Traffic Volume, Average Speed, Congestion Level
why_rejected: No licence, no stated data source, 1 star, created 2024-12-09 as a Power BI portfolio project.

SYNTHETIC SIGNATURE: weekday/weekend traffic-volume ratio is 0.984 — statistically no weekly structure. Real urban arterial traffic at Silk Board shows a substantial weekend reduction. Generated data typically does not.
Average speed reaches 81.9 km/h at Silk Board Junction, which is implausible for the junction in question.
Congestion Level and Road Capacity Utilization take exactly 100.0 in places, consistent with a clipped random generator.
Values carry 14 decimal places, consistent with generated floats rather than measurement.
sources_investigated.conclusion: This dataset appears to be synthetic. Labelling it 'real historical traffic data' would be a fabrication, so it is not used anywhere in this project.

real_world_context_noted_but_not_used_as.claim: Bengaluru police data reported the Silk Board double-decker flyover (opened 2025-07-18) reduced overall congestion by ~56%.
real_world_context_noted_but_not_used_as.why_not_used: A single reported percentage is not a demand time series, and the modelled network predates/does not represent the double-decker configuration. Recorded as context only; it is not an input to any simulation.

decision: No external traffic data is ingested. Demand remains this project's own ESTIMATED_DATA model. For DEMO MODE the spatial and temporal distribution of that model is intensified within its own calibrated envelope to resemble a busy urban arterial; the research demand is untouched and frozen.
ui_labelling_requirement: The interface must not display REAL-TIME or HISTORICAL for traffic. Demand is ESTIMATED_DATA and the resulting vehicle states are SIMULATED_DATA.
